objective: Gate 3B READ ONLY SQL de EDARSA Logistics. Validar exclusivamente metadatos del SQL canonico para cerrar naming, colisiones, objetos existentes y referencias fisicas antes de cualquier DDL. No consultar datos operativos sensibles ni modificar nada. Confirmar existencia/columnas de maestros BOS requeridos, patrones de PK/FK/nombres, objetos relacionados con activos/vehiculos/logistica/transporte, y detectar colisiones con candidatos Logistica_*. Clasificar los candidatos de Gate 2 como CONFIRMED_REUSE, CONFIRMED_EXTENSION, SAFE_NEW_CANDIDATE, COLLISION o REJECT. No crear tablas, migraciones, endpoints, codigo ni Gate 4. No tocar Produccion.

queries.name: logistics_like_existing_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE 'Logistica%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Logistic%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Transporte%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Vehicul%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Flota%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Viaje%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Embarque%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Entrega%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Mantenimiento%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Telemat%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME

queries.name: canonical_master_tables_presence
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('Sistema_Empresas','Sistema_Sucursales','Unidades_Negocio','Gobierno_Persona','Gobierno_Documento','Gobierno_DocumentoVersion','Gobierno_DocumentoMovimiento','Usuario_Catalogo','Cliente_Catalogo','Proveedor_Catalogo','Producto_Catalogo','Inventario_Almacenes','Inventario_Existencias','Inventario_Movimientos','Inventario_MovimientosDetalle') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME

queries.name: canonical_master_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, IS_NULLABLE, ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('Sistema_Empresas','Sistema_Sucursales','Unidades_Negocio','Gobierno_Persona','Gobierno_Documento','Usuario_Catalogo','Cliente_Catalogo','Proveedor_Catalogo','Producto_Catalogo','Inventario_Almacenes','Inventario_Existencias','Inventario_Movimientos','Inventario_MovimientosDetalle') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: asset_vehicle_candidate_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE 'Activo%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%ActivoFijo%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Vehiculo%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Equipo%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME

queries.name: primary_keys_relevant_objects
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, c.name AS column_name, ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id AND i.is_primary_key=1 JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE t.name IN ('Sistema_Empresas','Sistema_Sucursales','Unidades_Negocio','Gobierno_Persona','Gobierno_Documento','Usuario_Catalogo','Cliente_Catalogo','Proveedor_Catalogo','Producto_Catalogo','Inventario_Almacenes','Inventario_Existencias','Inventario_Movimientos','Inventario_MovimientosDetalle') ORDER BY t.name, ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: foreign_key_patterns_relevant_objects
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_table, COL_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id,fkc.parent_column_id) AS child_column, OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS parent_table, COL_NAME(fkc.referenced_object_id,fkc.referenced_column_id) AS parent_column, fk.name AS fk_name FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id WHERE OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN ('Sistema_Sucursales','Unidades_Negocio','Gobierno_Documento','Cliente_Catalogo','Proveedor_Catalogo','Inventario_Almacenes','Inventario_Existencias','Inventario_Movimientos','Inventario_MovimientosDetalle') OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) IN ('Sistema_Empresas','Sistema_Sucursales','Unidades_Negocio','Gobierno_Persona','Usuario_Catalogo','Cliente_Catalogo','Proveedor_Catalogo','Producto_Catalogo','Inventario_Almacenes') ORDER BY child_table, fk_name

queries.name: finance_purchase_document_naming_patterns
